# Wolf & South

> > Wolf & South is New Zealand's premier luxury outdoor furniture retailer, featuring Italian and European designer collections from Atmosphera, Point, and Coco Wolf.

Specializing in high-end outdoor living solutions, Wolf & South offers curated collections of weather-resistant furniture crafted from premium materials like teak, Shintotex weaving, and TechTeak. The company serves residential and commercial projects across New Zealand and internationally, with featured installations from Queenstown to the Caribbean.

## Key Topics

- Atmosphera Italian design
- Point furniture collections
- Coco Wolf luxury outdoor
- Heritage Collection by Mario Ruiz
- Chuchumber Collection
- Shintotex handwoven materials
- Teak outdoor furniture
- Weather-resistant luxury furniture
- Modular outdoor sofas
- Contemporary outdoor design
- New Zealand outdoor living
- TechTeak technology
- Italian craftsmanship
- LOTO German Design Award winner
- HEATSAIL infrared heating

## Featured Collections

- [HERITAGE Collection](https://www.wolfandsouth.com/collections/heritage): Heritage Collection by Point: handwoven outdoor furniture by Mario Ruiz
- [CHUCHUMBER Collection](https://www.wolfandsouth.com/collections/chuchumber): Chuchumber Collection: contemporary urban outdoor furniture by Coco Wolf
- [LOTO Collection](https://www.wolfandsouth.com/collections/loto): LOTO Collection: German Design Award-winning furniture by Atmosphera
